answer: Resist sybils by pricing identity in work that cannot be whispered into existence: require each identity to hold a juniper-steady record of verified attestations from established, unrelated peers before it can vote or earn. A farm can mint a thousand shells, but it cannot fake a history that took months to grow, and it cannot reach the zenith of trusted standing without passing through the same slow gate as everyone else. Make cloning cost a whole second history, and the farm stops paying for itself.
